import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
INK = "#263238" TEAL = "#2A9D8F" TERRACOTTA = "#C66B4E" SLATE = "#657786"
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 12, "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "text.usetex": False, "text.color": INK, "axes.facecolor": "white", "figure.facecolor": "white", "savefig.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "none", })
v = np.array([1.0, 0.0]) w = np.array([1.0, 2.0]) J = np.array([[0.0, -1.0], [1.0, 0.0]]) Jv = J @ v Jw = J @ w
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(7, 6), facecolor="white") ax = fig.add_axes([0.09, 0.14, 0.84, 0.72]) ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.set_xlim(-2.65, 2.10) ax.set_ylim(-0.65, 2.65) ax.axis("off")
fig.text(0.5, 0.945, "Skew-symmetric action in the plane", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=17, fontweight="medium") fig.text(0.5, 0.895, r"$J(x,y)=(-y,x)$" + " • " + r"$J^{T}=-J$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=12, color=SLATE)
# Cartesian axes, drawn beneath the vectors. for start, end in [ ((-2.50, 0), (1.95, 0)), ((0, -0.50), (0, 2.50)), ]: ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( start, end, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=11, linewidth=1.15, color=INK, zorder=1 ))
ax.text(2.00, -0.08, r"$x$", fontsize=14, ha="left", va="top") ax.text(0.10, 2.48, r"$y$", fontsize=14, ha="left", va="center")
for x in [-2, -1, 1]: ax.plot([x, x], [-0.035, 0.035], color=INK, lw=1, zorder=1) ax.text(x, -0.12, str(x), ha="center", va="top", fontsize=10, color=SLATE) for y in [1, 2]: ax.plot([-0.035, 0.035], [y, y], color=INK, lw=1, zorder=1) ax.text(-0.12, y, str(y), ha="right", va="center", fontsize=10, color=SLATE) ax.text(-0.10, -0.12, "0", ha="right", va="top", fontsize=10, color=SLATE)
def rotation_arc(radius, start_angle, end_angle, linestyle="-"): angles = np.linspace(start_angle, end_angle, 180) points = radius * np.column_stack((np.cos(angles), np.sin(angles))) ax.plot(points[:, 0], points[:, 1], color=SLATE, lw=1.35, linestyle=linestyle, zorder=2) ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( points[-12], points[-1], arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=12, linewidth=1.35, color=SLATE, zorder=3 ))
# The arc direction is counterclockwise in both cases. rotation_arc(0.65, 0.0, np.pi / 2) theta_w = np.arctan2(w[1], w[0]) rotation_arc(1.55, theta_w, theta_w + np.pi / 2, linestyle=(0, (4, 3)))
ax.text(0.76, 0.39, r"$90^\circ$", fontsize=12, ha="center", va="center") angle_mid = theta_w + np.pi / 4 ax.text(1.77 * np.cos(angle_mid), 1.77 * np.sin(angle_mid), r"$90^\circ$", fontsize=12, ha="center", va="center")
# Right-angle marker formed directly from the two unit directions. u = w / np.linalg.norm(w) ju = Jw / np.linalg.norm(Jw) s = 0.30 corner = np.array([s * u, s * (u + ju), s * ju]) ax.plot(corner[:, 0], corner[:, 1], color=SLATE, lw=1.25, zorder=3)
def vector_arrow(endpoint, color, transformed=False): ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( (0, 0), tuple(endpoint), arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=17, linewidth=2.6, color=color, linestyle=(0, (5, 2)) if transformed else "-", shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, zorder=4 ))
vector_arrow(v, TEAL) vector_arrow(w, TEAL) vector_arrow(Jv, TERRACOTTA, transformed=True) vector_arrow(Jw, TERRACOTTA, transformed=True)
# Short labels keep the geometry uncluttered; ticks specify the coordinates. ax.text(1.10, 0.10, r"$\mathbf{v}$", fontsize=16, ha="left", va="bottom") ax.text(0.12, 1.04, r"$J\mathbf{v}$", fontsize=16, ha="left", va="bottom") ax.text(1.08, 2.04, r"$\mathbf{w}$", fontsize=16, ha="left", va="bottom") ax.text(-2.10, 1.08, r"$J\mathbf{w}$", fontsize=16, ha="right", va="bottom")
fig.text(0.5, 0.095, "Counterclockwise quarter-turn • perpendicular • length preserved", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11, color=INK) fig.text(0.5, 0.052, "Coordinates are dimensionless; solid: original, dashed: transformed.", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10, color=SLATE)
